prompt.note: The Markdown system prompt is on the operator's DeepSeek Harness setup. A victim-side prompt log would not show it.

task.note: The operator gives a subnet and plain-language instructions in the framework's web UI. That UI is the attacker's, not the victim's.

exploit.note: ACN says the agents try known vulnerabilities and unauthenticated interfaces first. It does not publish the request paths.

pivot.note: ACN says the agents set up tunnels and remote-control components. It does not name the tunnel software, so no persistence profile is assigned.

adapt.note: ACN says the agents write malicious code in real time. It does not publish a stable command line.
